S_G_C_STRIKE.title: Strike
S_G_C_DEFEND.title: Defend
S_G_C_GETTER_BEAM.title: Getter Beam
S_G_C_GETTER_BEAM.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Apply {Wane:diff()} [gold]Wane[/gold].
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Deal additional damage equal to the total [gold]Ki[/gold] gained this combat.
S_G_C_GETTER_LAUNCH.title: Getter Launch
S_G_C_DIVE_STRIKE.title: Dive Strike
S_G_C_DIVE_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. If you are [gold]Airborne[/gold], double this damage.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain 1 [gold]Airborne[/gold].
S_G_C_HURRICANE_STRIKE.title: Hurricane Strike
S_G_C_HURRICANE_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Draw 1 card for each target hit.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Gain [gold]Shade[/gold].
S_G_C_GETTER_CHOP.title: Getter Chop
S_G_C_GETTER_CHOP.description: Steal {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] from the enemy 2 times. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 2 times.
S_G_C_GETTER_ELBOW.title: Getter Elbow
S_G_C_SHIFT_STRIKE.title: Shift Strike
S_G_C_FOCUS_FIRE.title: Focus Fire
S_G_C_FOCUS_FIRE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has a debuff, deal 10 additional damage.
S_G_C_GETTER_TOMAHAWK.title: Getter Tomahawk
S_G_C_GETTER_TOMAHAWK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. At the start of next turn, play this 1 additional time.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain 2 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
S_G_C_GETTER_CLAW.title: Getter Claw
S_G_C_GETTER_CLAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever a card is Exhausted, return this card to your hand.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Play 1 additional time.
S_G_C_GETTER_RUSH.title: Getter Rush
S_G_C_GETTER_RUSH.description:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Trigger [gold]Plating[/gold] 1 time.
S_G_C_MELTDOWN.title: Meltdown
S_G_C_KI.title: Spirit
S_G_C_INDOMITABLE.title: Persist
S_G_C_INDOMITABLE.description:
Gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. Convert the next {SGP_Indomitable:diff()} instances of damage into [gold]Delayed Damage[/gold].
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
S_G_C_TACTICAL_RETREAT.title: Tactical Retreat
S_G_C_BLACK_ARMOR.title: Black Getter Mod
S_G_C_BLACK_ARMOR.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Reduce your [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [gold]Weak[/gold], and [gold]Frail[/gold] by 1 each.
S_G_C_SHED_LOAD.title: Shed Load
S_G_C_SHED_LOAD.description:
Lose all [gold]Ki[/gold]. For each [gold]Ki[/gold] lost, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: For each [gold]Ki[/gold] lost, also gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold].
S_G_C_HEDGEHOG_TACTIC.title: Hedgehog Tactic
S_G_C_CHANGE_ATTACK.title: Change Attack
S_G_C_CHANGE_ATTACK.description: [gold]Transform[/gold] X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} times. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage each time.
S_G_C_ANNIHILATION.title: Annihilation
S_G_C_ANNIHILATION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {Wane:diff()} [gold]Wane[/gold]. Each time you deal damage, add 1 [gold]Radiated[/gold] to your hand.
S_G_C_HOT_BLOOD.title: Valor
S_G_C_HOT_BLOOD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next Attack deals double damage.
S_G_C_TOMAHAWK_FURY.title: Tomahawk Fury
S_G_C_TOMAHAWK_FURY.description:
Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies 2 times.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: When this kills an enemy, gain 3 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
S_G_C_GETTER_FLASH.title: Getter Flash
S_G_C_GETTER_FLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain 2 [gold]Vigor[/gold] and 2 [gold]Airborne[/gold].
S_G_C_GETTER_RAY_OVERFLOW.title: Getter Ray Burst
S_G_C_GETTER_RAY_OVERFLOW.description: For this combat, all cards with "Getter" in their name cost {SGP_GetterRayOverflow:diff()} less. Whenever you play a Getter card, gain {SGP_GetterRayOverflow:diff()} [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray].
S_G_C_TORNADO_DRILL.title: Tornado Drill
S_G_C_TORNADO_DRILL.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Deal double damage to [gold]Block[/gold].
S_G_C_SPIRAL_DRILL.title: Spiral Drill
S_G_C_SPIRAL_DRILL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Damage ignores [gold]Block[/gold].
S_G_C_EXPANSION_STRIKE.title: Expansion Strike
S_G_C_EXPANSION_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each abnormal status on you and this enemy.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Gain 2 [gold]Plating[/gold] for each abnormal status.
S_G_C_GETTER_MISSILE.title: Getter Missile
S_G_C_GETTER_MISSILE.description:
Randomly deal {Damage:diff()} damage 4 times among all characters.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: When this hits you, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the damage.
S_G_C_EVOLUTION_RESONANCE.title: Evolution Resonance
S_G_C_SEIZE_FUTURE.title: Seize the Future
S_G_C_SEIZE_FUTURE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Reduce the cost of 1 card in your hand by 1 this turn.
S_G_C_SEIZE_FUTURE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose 1 card to cost 1 less this turn.
S_G_C_SPIRIT.title: Drive
S_G_C_SPIRIT.description: Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]. Transform {Cards:diff()} card(s) in your hand into [gold]Spirit{IfUpgraded:show:+}[/gold].
S_G_C_SPIRIT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose cards to transform into Spirit.
S_G_C_PARTS_SWAP.title: Parts Swap
S_G_C_PARTS_SWAP.description: Choose up to {Cards:diff()} cards in your hand and swap them with cards in your Exhaust pile.
S_G_C_TRIPLE_UNITY.title: Triple Unity
S_G_C_TRIPLE_UNITY.description: After you play the next {SGP_TripleUnity:diff()} cards, [gold]Transform[/gold].
S_G_C_DARK_CAPE.title: Black Cape
S_G_C_DARK_CAPE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. This turn, whenever [gold]Block[/gold] fully blocks damage, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain 3 [gold]Airborne[/gold].
S_G_C_BACKUP_PLAN.title: Backup Plan
S_G_C_BACKUP_PLAN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Exhaust any number of cards in your hand. For each card type Exhausted, draw 1 card.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
S_G_C_BACKUP_PLAN.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose any number of cards to Exhaust.
S_G_C_GRAPPLE.title: Grapple
S_G_C_GRAPPLE.description:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold]. Multi-hit attacks hit {SGP_Grapple:diff()} fewer time(s) this turn.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: The enemy loses {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
S_G_C_JAMMER.title: Jammer
S_G_C_OVERLOAD.title: Overload
S_G_C_ACCELERATION.title: Accel
S_G_C_ACCELERATION.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} additional card(s).
S_G_C_INSIGHT.title: Foresight
S_G_C_INSIGHT.description:
At the start of your turn, if an enemy intends to attack, gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
S_G_C_CHOSEN_ONE.title: Chosen One
S_G_C_SAOTOME_BLUEPRINT.title: Saotome Blueprint
S_G_C_WARRIOR_MEDAL.title: Warrior Medal
S_G_C_WARRIOR_MEDAL.description: At the start of your turn, gain {SGP_WarriorMedal:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold] and [gold]Plating[/gold].
S_G_C_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.title: Fighting Spirit
S_G_C_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.description: Before being attacked, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to the attacker.
S_G_C_CHAIN_REACTION.title: Chain Reaction
S_G_C_STAR_SLASH.title: Star-Slashing Axe
S_G_C_STAR_SLASH.description:
Exhaust {Cards:diff()} card(s) from your draw pile and [gold]stack[/gold] their printed values onto this card. Deal {Damage:diff()} base damage.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain {Vigor:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] for each card exhausted this way.
S_G_C_FINAL_GETTER_BEAM.title: Final Getter Beam
S_G_C_FINAL_GETTER_BEAM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {SGP_Wane:diff()} [gold]Wane[/gold]. Whenever that enemy takes unblocked damage, its [gold]Wane[/gold] increases by {SGP_FinalGetterBeam:diff()}.
S_G_C_SHINING_SPARK.title: Shining Spark
S_G_C_SHINING_SPARK.description: Gain 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and 1 [gold]Frail[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. For each [gold]Ki[/gold], deal {KiDamage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
S_G_C_LIGER_ASSAULT.title: Liger Assault
S_G_C_LIGER_ASSAULT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} times.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Gain [gold]Shade[/gold] and {BufferPower:diff()} [gold]Buffer[/gold].
S_G_C_AVALANCHE.title: Daisetsuzan Oroshi
S_G_C_AVALANCHE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Lose all [gold]Block[/gold]; each [gold]Block[/gold] lost adds 1 damage.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Each [gold]Plating[/gold] adds 1 damage.
S_G_C_POSEIDON_THUNDER.title: Poseidon Thunder
S_G_C_POSEIDON_THUNDER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold], and {FrailPower:diff()} [gold]Frail[/gold].
S_G_C_STEEL_SPIRIT.title: Soul of Steel
S_G_C_STEEL_SPIRIT.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Add a random [blue]Spirit Command card[/blue] to your hand and play it.|Play a random [blue]Spirit Command card[/blue] from your hand, draw pile, or discard pile.}
S_G_C_GETTER_WILL.title: Getter Will
S_G_C_GETTER_WILL.description:
Choose {Cards:diff()} Power card(s) from your draw pile and add them to your hand.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain {SGP_Evolution:diff()} [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray].
S_G_C_GETTER_WILL.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Cards:diff()} Power card(s) to add to your hand.
S_G_C_SPECIALIZATION.title: Specialization
S_G_C_SPECIALIZATION.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Add {Cards:diff()} random [gold]form-exclusive card(s)[/gold] for your current form to your hand. They cost 0 this turn.
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Gain 4 [gold]Regen[/gold].
S_G_C_IRON_WALL.title: Wall
S_G_C_IRON_WALL.description:
[gold]Transform[/gold] into [yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]. Until the start of next turn, reduce damage taken by {SGP_IronWall:diff()}.
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Whenever you take damage, gain 1 [gold]Plating[/gold].
S_G_C_GUTS.title: Prevail
S_G_C_GETTER_NOVA.title: Getter Nova
S_G_C_BOLD_PLAN.title: Bold Plan
S_G_C_BOLD_PLAN.description:
Gain X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} [gold]Radiation[/gold] and X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} [gold]Ki[/gold]. Draw X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} card(s). Cards drawn this way gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
[gold]Getter 2[/gold]: Choose 1 card in your hand and enchant it with [gold]Adaptation[/gold].
S_G_C_AWAKENED_SOUL.title: Awakened Soul
S_G_C_AWAKENED_SOUL.description: Gain {SGP_AwakenedSoul:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]. At the start of your turn, gain {SGP_AwakenedSoul:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
S_G_C_SUPER_KI.title: Super Spirit
S_G_C_SUPER_KI.description: Gain {SGP_Ki:diff()} [gold]Ki[/gold]. At the start of each turn, add 1 [gold]Spirit[/gold] to your hand.
S_G_C_EVOLUTION_ENGINE.title: Evolution Engine
S_G_C_ENABLE.title: Enable
S_G_C_ENABLE.description: [gold]Transform[/gold] into [red]Shin Getter 1[/red]. End your turn. Gain {SGP_Enable:diff()} extra turn(s).
S_G_C_ANTI_EVOLUTION.title: Anti-Evolution Body
S_G_C_ANTI_EVOLUTION.description: Apply {SGP_Seal:diff()} turn(s) of [gold]Seal[/gold] to ALL characters.
S_G_C_DESPERATION.title: Desperation
S_G_C_DESPERATION.description:
Gain {SGP_Evolution:diff()} [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray] and {SGP_Ki:diff()} [gold]Ki[/gold]. Reduce HP to 1. At the end of combat, heal the HP lost.
[red]Shin Getter 1[/red]: Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
[white]Shin Getter 2[/white]: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
[yellow]Shin Getter 3[/yellow]: Gain {BufferPower:diff()} [gold]Buffer[/gold] and {ArtifactPower:diff()} [gold]Artifact[/gold].
S_G_C_STONER_SUNSHINE.title: Stoner Sunshine
S_G_C_STONER_SUNSHINE.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {Wane:diff()} [gold]Wane[/gold]. Deal additional damage equal to the [gold]Vigor[/gold] gained this combat.
S_G_C_SHIN_FORM.title: Shin Form
S_G_C_SHIN_FORM.description: [gold]Transform[/gold] into [getter_ray]Shin Getter Dragon[/getter_ray], and count as all three forms. Costs 1 less for each [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray] gained.
S_G_C_RADIATED.title: Radiated
S_G_C_RADIATED.description: Gain {SGP_Evolution:diff()} [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray]. ALL characters take {Damage:diff()} damage and gain {SGP_Radiation:diff()} [gold]Radiation[/gold].
S_G_C_INSECT_VIRUS.title: Insect-Human Virus
S_G_C_INSECT_VIRUS.description: While in your hand, gain 4 [gold]Wane[/gold] at the end of each turn.
S_G_C_INFINITE_EVOLUTION.title: Infinite Evolution
S_G_C_INFINITE_EVOLUTION.description: After winning combat, randomly gain 1 permanent [gold]Strength[/gold], [gold]Dexterity[/gold], or Max HP.
S_G_C_HOLY_DRAGON_ROAR.title: Holy Dragon Roar
S_G_C_HOLY_DRAGON_ROAR.description:
Exhaust all [gold]Getter cards[/gold] in your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()} base damage to ALL enemies. Each card Exhausted adds {BurnDamage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Stun[/gold] ALL enemies.
